title: prunus armeniaca subsp. brigantina
intro: Prunus armeniaca subsp. brigantina, commonly known as the apricot kernel, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). The apricot kernel is a small, hard seed extracted from the fruit of Prunus armeniaca, a deciduous tree native to Central Asia. The health benefits of apricot kernel include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, as well as its antioxidant properties which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The apricot kernel is rich in bioactive constituents such as amygdalin, a cyanogenic glycoside that has been reported to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
